gate_1_equals_by_hand.claim: a study over a kind's vector setting, whole or by a component, equals the same points written by hand as experiments of their own, bit for bit per point: each point's program (its structure key without the axis's value), parameter leaves and initial state are the hand-written experiment's, and each member's final state and recorded series are the hand-written experiment's member run the same way (a study of it over a scalar axis at the same values, the same batched scan at the same batch size)

prediction.unit: arrays differing (structure keys, leaves, initial states, final states, series)
prediction.why: a point's declarations are the base's with the thing's declaration replaced by one whose kind holds the value, which is what the hand-written script declares; each point is planned and built in full, and a group holds one value of the setting, so its program is built from that value; a member of a batch of one (or two) runs the batched scan the hand-written study runs at that batch size, on the same leaves and state

gate_1_equals_by_hand.metric: np.array_equal of every array, and equality of the structure keys

control.plant: keep-base: the point's write of the setting returns the experiment's own value (a rebuilt point that silently keeps the base); next-index: a component written at the next index along (a wrong component index)
control.expected_rate: N/N for both, on the egg's and the tree's component cases (and the whole cases for keep-base): each moves the built kind by 0.05 to 0.15 mm, which changes the drag node's force points or the tree's cell mask, far above a bit
control.resolution: one bit: the comparison is array equality

gate_1_equals_by_hand.if_wrong: a difference names the array and the point; a structure key that differs means the point did not declare what the script declares (the write), and a member that differs with an equal program means the batched run differs, which gate 1 of tests/study (a batch of one is its own scan bit for bit) says it does not
gate_1_equals_by_hand.cannot_discriminate_if: the moved values gave the same program and leaves as the base (then keep-base would pass): the cases move each value enough to change the drag's sampling or the tree's mask, and the test asserts that the hand-written builds of two values differ

gate_2_split_per_value.claim: each value of a built axis is a group of its own, its split reason naming the axis; the same value twice is one group; the plan states the declared cut (no derivative along the axis)
gate_2_split_per_value.case: the plans of gate 1's cases, and the egg over semi_axes[2] at 1.1, 1.25, 1.1 mm

prediction.value: groups = the distinct values (2 in each of gate 1's cases; and 2 for 1.1, 1.25, 1.1 with members 0 and 2 together); each later group's first reason 'its value of <path>, a kind's setting the build holds as built (one build a value)'
prediction.why: the point's key is its structure key with a digest of the setting's whole value, and the reasons are computed from the axes before the records

gate_3_refusals.claim: what stays refused is refused with its code and route: a component path on a value that is not a vector of numbers (study.component-path), a component past the end (study.component-index), a whole point of another length or dimension and a component of another dimension (study.vector-value), a kind's setting that is a structure, names or a reference (study.held-geometry), a setting named whole and by a component (study.axis-twice), a derivative or a fit along a built axis (gradient.built-value), an override of one (override.structural), a range of one (range.units)

prediction.value: each code as listed, the message naming the path

gate_4_inert.claim: a built axis whose values change no structure, leaf, initial state or traced step is refused (study.axis-inert); one whose values a node holds as built in its traced step alone is not
gate_4_inert.case: the periodic tree as a structure no medium fills (vessel.radii[3]): refused; a box-hulled body with no law (its size held by the rigid body as floats it derives at build, if the trace shows them): judged by the trace

prediction.value: the tree refused; the box either not refused (its trace differs) or refused (then nothing reads it), said by the test from the trace itself
prediction.basis: guess for the box: the rigid body's hull-derived Python floats are named as an anomaly in the release notes, and whether they reach the step is not read here

gate_5_saved.claim: a study over built axes saves and reads back: its spec file names the axes with their component paths and values (a component one number with its unit, a whole vector its numbers), and a study made from it is the same study (the same id, the same points and group keys); a folder written by run_to is read back equal to the result in memory and a second run_to resumes every member

prediction.value: equal ids, keys, coordinates and members; every member reused on resume
